blocks.text: The City agrees that under K.S.A. 12-2001 and K.S.A 17-1902 , and other state and federal laws, this Contract Franchise ordinance must be competitively neutral and may not be unreasonable or discriminatory to any telecommunications provider operating in the City. (Ord. 20581 § 15, 8-12-25.)
